title: All Rights Reserved
summary: A page that guards its artwork by disabling right-click while a Creative Commons licence on the same page begs you to copy it.
mechanism: contextmenu preventDefault() is a real, functioning lock that blocks only the browser menu; a live ledger counts intercepted right-clicks while Reproductions-prevented stays frozen at 0.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
net.art / the Web 1.0 'no right-click' image-protection script
Olia Lialina & Dragan Espenschied, One Terabyte of Kilobyte Age
